specFidelityNotes: Diff origin/main..HEAD (#526 P2.10-A2). analytics_kpi_precompute package implements shop-scoped GMV (TikTok) precompute: build_gmv_tiktok_kpi reads shop-grain analytics_performance_intervals with non-null gmv, builds {t,v} series; precompute_shop_analytics_kpis merges gmv_tiktok into kind=analytics envelope via AnalyticsKpiEnvelopesRepo.upsert with JSONB-safe copy/merge. unavailable when no usable GMV rows (no fabricated series); label GMV (TikTok) / gmv_tiktok key / no net_revenue alias. Three pytest cases cover available path, no-interval unavailable, null-gmv-only unavailable, upsert round-trip, and label law.

convention_notes.note: Envelope currency defaults to VND in _base_envelope_payload; gmv_currency from interval rows is not propagated when present. Default VND satisfies fixtures and #525 envelope shape; multi-currency propagation deferred.
Public API precompute_shop_analytics_kpis and build_gmv_tiktok_kpi documented with payload contract and dependencies.
